description: Third-party source vendored into the MMT-DPI tree (issue #496, F-DEP-305). One entry per component: where it lives, where it comes from, the pinned upstream revision and its licence. tools/ci/vendored-components.py check verifies the entries against the tree; tools/ci/vendored-components.py sbom adds them to the release SPDX SBOM as packages. tools/ci/vendor-paths.txt stays the list of files excluded from the clean-code metrics and the coverage denominators; every path it names must belong to a component here.
